title: is baat se zaahir hai rutba ali akbar ka
body:
Is baat se zahir hai rutba Ali Akbar ka
Hota hai Azaano’n me characha Ali Akbar ka,
<<DIVIDER>>
Aey Hurr teri qismat ne kyu aj yeh karwat li
Kya subha ko dekha tha chehra Ali Akbar ka.
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ke jhoole ko jibreel jhulaate the
shabbir jhulaate hai jhoola ali akbar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir jhulate the abbas ke jhoole ko
abbas jhulate he jhoola ali akbar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Poocha gaya Yousuf se jab husn ke baare me.
haskar kaha ye to hai sadqa ali akbar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
laila ne kaha baithu kis tarha mai saye me
phirta he nigaho me chehra ali akbar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
poocha gaya jab sheh se kyu qam hai kamar mola
bole ke uthaya tha lasha ali akbar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Hota hai Azaano’n me characha Ali Akbar ka
